tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to make, create, generate or send an invoice, bill, quote, estimate or receipt, or asks for an "invoice PDF" or "invoice template filled in". Calculates line totals, tax, discount and shipping and returns a download link to a print-ready PDF plus the totals. Ask for miss

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_invoice" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
